title: Guard block run advances by the requested length
statement: Let $b$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a finite Boolean string, and let $j,u\in\mathbb N$ with $j\le |x|$, $u\le b+1$, and $j+u\le |x|$. For any Boolean output string $out$, after $u$ steps of the guard machine with parameter $b$ from position $j$ in phase zero, the configuration is at position $j+u$ in phase $u$ modulo $b+1$, with output unchanged.
